A proud moment for Santoor Women’s Scholarship!

It gives us immense pleasure to see our first batch of girls graduating successfully. We congratulate them and wish them all the best for the future.

The Santoor Scholarship program is an initiative of Wipro Consumer Care and Wipro Cares. The program intends to financially support girls from disadvantaged backgrounds, who wish to pursue higher education after grade 12. This year, the Santoor Scholarship will extend financial support to 1000 eligible girl students, across the states of Andhra Pradesh and Maharashtra.

It is a recurring annual program and the selected students are supported for the duration of their higher education. The support covers tuition fees and incidental expenses.

Over the last eight years, close to 8000 students have received support through the Santoor Scholarship Program.

Besides students inclined towards professional courses, those showing a keen interest in pursuing their higher education in the fields of humanities, liberal arts and sciences are strongly encouraged to apply. Preference is given to students from backward districts.

Students from previous year from Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka and Chhattisgarh receiving scholarships, will continue to get the scholarship till end of their undergraduate studies if eligible.
